implementedScopes: Profile-private complete PPTX journals for named and unnamed presentations, with AutoSave off supported
Non-blurring capture of pending rich text, table-cell text, speaker notes, and master/layout text
Presentation/part/load/edit guards keep late notes reads from replacing newer text; initial baselines load before editing, while same-part reloads remain editable
Part-bound notes writes resolve inside the main mutation and refuse missing parts after a reorder; coalesced previous-part flushes preserve failed pending text
Batch-result notes reconciliation keeps pending data visible to recovery and Save, waits before flush, rejects old-source replies, and preserves text on read rejection
Failed baseline comparisons remain a retry fence before later writes; Undo/Redo history epochs reject obsolete queued flushes, failed-write restoration and late baseline receipts
Committed master/layout geometry and styles retained from the archive while master view remains open
Independent archive/model copy preserves original media, relationships and opaque parts without altering live Save acknowledgments
Per-view Session-bound activation, monotonic sequence, path rename and caller-only save/discard epochs
Revision checks before queued capture and before journal writing; changed or reparsed source refuses stale overlays visibly
Root Recovery synchronously invalidates an active producer and suppresses unchanged discarded content
Bounded clone graph, pending payload, complete compressed package and global serialization queue; failures retain the last complete journal
Close and Save wait for pending text/notes; newer edits during a Save remain unsaved
